widths.note: west of McLean; printed 50' east of McLean

ends.note: Curran (NOT OPEN) drawn only as dashed lines from Hopkins north to the diagonal C.N.O.&T.P. siding/platform; not drawn through to Kenner (lumber yard and American Railway Express Co. building occupy the line)

notes: North is up. Horne printed 'HORNE (NOT OPEN)'; only its east side (block line x~320) is on the sheet, the paper edge is at x~225, so Horne centre (x=235) is taken half its 50 ft width (25 ft, ~87 px at ~3.47 px/ft) west of that line and sits right at the sheet edge. McLean printed 'McLEAN AV. (NOT OPEN)', 100 ft: west side is a dashed line x~1803-1810 alongside the C.N.O.&T.P. tracks, east side x~2155 (dashed at Hopkins), centre ~1980; the double dashed line at x~2040 is the 10" water pipe, not the centre. Courtland (Florence), Kenner, Sedgewick, Flint and Hopkins cross the railroad corridor west of McLean only as dashed (not open) lines; Flint's dashed lines stop at x~1487 at the railroad edge (blank/sheet 77 beyond). Courtland does not continue east of McLean (American Oak Leather Co. works). Dalton Av.: only its west side (building/lot line x~3815-3832) is on the sheet; centre taken half its 60 ft width (~104 px) east of it, close to the right paper edge (~3953); the double dashed line at x~3885-3895 is the 10" water pipe, not the centre. Dalton is printed '(NOT OPEN)' between Kenner and Hopkins (west side dashed there). Flint's north side is off the top edge; Flint centre taken half its 60 ft width (~104 px) north of the leather company's north line (y~370). Hopkins printed '(NOT OPEN)'; its north side jogs at McLean (y 4409 west, 4439 east) while widths change 60' -> 50', south sides line up.
